newsitem.title: USA: ABC Rail plant closing delayed.
newsitem.headline: ABC Rail plant closing delayed.

text.p: ABC Rail Products Corp said Thursday a delay in closing a money-losing plant and process changes helped depress earnings for the railroad equipment maker in the third quarter ended April 30.
Sales for the quarter were $73.8 million, compared with $60.1 million a year ago.
In 1997, sales would have been higher but for slowed output at the company's wheel plant due to process changes that will ultimately improve productivity, the company said.

Also, major product design changes by Class I railroad customers as a result of recent mergers in the industry which temporarily affected production output at trackwork plants hurt sales, the company said.
ABC also said closing a money losing plant obtained as part of its acqusition of Deco Industries has been delayed because of the need to complete work for a major customer.

"And on top of these individual situations, we have been stretched because the unexpected consolidation of the rail industry has forced us into plant restructuring to install just-in-time cells, new computer systems and other cost-saving programs in parallel rather than sequentially," chief financial officer D. Chisholm MacDonald said in a news release.
Earlier Thursday, the company reported net income of $263,000 or $0.03 a share before a $0.03 a share charge for the third quarter, compared to a loss of $2.5 million, or $0.30 a share a year ago.
ABC Rail shares were up 1/2 at 17-3/8 Thursday.
